verdict.rationale: DeepInfra's own docs describe deploying a dedicated instance on A100/H100/H200/B200/B300 GPUs with autoscaling and a private endpoint, positioned for data isolation. Its OpenAPI spec also lists custom model deployments as a distinct offering from serverless inference. The evidence is summary-level only: missing for 10: detailed docs on autoscaling configuration (min/max replicas, scale-to-zero, scaling triggers), explicit documentation that dedicated traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can deploy a model on dedicated GPU capacity with autoscaling so my traffic is isolated from the shared serverless pool
